title: Review pages: two tall pictures side by side

steps.path: Any review page showing a tall popup before and after (here: Submit a ticket, round 1)
steps.headline: Review pages now show two tall pictures side by side, shrunk to fit the screen, instead of one under the other.
steps.changed: Two tall pictures (taller than wide) are never stacked any more; they shrink until both fit beside each other. Short, wide pictures are laid out exactly as before.
steps.notice: You see Today and Proposed whole, next to each other, without scrolling. They are smaller; the + button beside the pictures zooms in.
steps.risk: On a small window the pictures can get small enough that fine detail needs the zoom button.

labels.today: A review slide of a tall popup
